rules: One clip per scene, so the voice stays in the same take. Eight clips in total.
Each line starts when its scene starts and must fit inside that scene's window at the voice's natural pace (no speed-up, no pitch change in the primary cut).
Speaking pace of this voice is about 2.5 words per second. Lines are sized to about 80% of their window.
Hinglish: Hindi in Devanagari, technical and English words in Latin script.

lines.text: हर AI app को, हर tool के लिए अलग plug चाहिए.
Host: आपकी AI app. Client: एक server से जुड़ा. Server: tools देता है.
Server तीन चीज़ें देता है: tools, resources और prompts.
पहले discover करो. फिर tools की list. फिर JSON से tool call करो. आख़िर में, result model तक.
